verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly from left to right: logo, can, headline with subcopy, then CTA. Its flaws: the SOLSTICE logo is tiny, there's an empty gap between the logo and the can, and the NEW FLAVOR badge is jammed against the bottom edge on top of the translucent circle, away from its copy. B makes the logo unreadable: it's a speck under the can near the bottom edge, so the brand is effectively lost. B also crams the NEW FLAVOR badge onto the end of the subcopy line, lets the background circle run behind 'the Light', and makes the subcopy small next to an oversized headline.
